frozen: 2026-10-31, before any run of the changes below; the T8 station results and T5 Konkan result of plan.json (tests.json, sea.json) were known

autumn_mud.change: a 25 mm topsoil bucket in front of the 100 mm soil bucket: rain and melt fill it, PET empties it first when the ground is not frozen, what it cannot hold passes to the 100 mm bucket; mud = max(the present rule, clip((topsoil / 25 - 0.75) / 0.25, 0, 1)) when the ground is not frozen. 25 mm is the water the top ~10 cm of a loam holds against drainage; fixed, not fitted.

checks.Kyiv: mud >= 0.5 in Mar, Apr, Oct, Nov (plan.json T8; now Mar only)
checks.Moscow: mud >= 0.5 in Apr and in at least one of Oct, Nov (spring and autumn rasputitsa)
checks.no_new_mud: no month newly reaching mud >= 0.5 at Rome Jun-Sep, Patna Oct-May, Cairo any month, Beijing Oct-Feb

autumn_mud.climate: WorldClim 2.1 5' monthly tavg, tmax, tmin, prec at the station points, months from January (the T8 convention)
autumn_mud.adopt_if: Kyiv reaches at least 3 of its 4 months, Moscow passes, and no no_new_mud check fails; then the map's political-reach layers are rebuilt with it. The Roman and Han extent tests cannot be rerun in this container (their datasets are not cached); this is reported.

monsoon_coasts_diagnostic.rule: sea cells within 100 km of land: onshore component of the monthly vector-mean wind >= 5.5 m/s (Beaufort 4) uncertain, >= 8.0 m/s (Beaufort 5) closed

earth_expectations.Konkan (16 N, 71 E): not open in Jun, Jul, Aug; open in Dec, Jan, Feb (T5; its numbers were seen, so this is not blind)
earth_expectations.Coromandel (13 N, 81 E): not open in Nov; open in Mar, Apr (north-east monsoon on the east coast)
earth_expectations.Alexandria approaches (31.5 N, 29.9 E): open in Jun, Jul, Aug (Mediterranean summer sailing)

monsoon_coasts_diagnostic.map_check: share of the map's coastal sea cells (within 100 km of land) the rule would make uncertain or closed in each month with the model's winds
monsoon_coasts_diagnostic.decision: diagnostic only; adopted for the map only if all four Earth expectations hold and the rule leaves at least 90 % of the map's coastal sea open in the three summer months
